```{r include=FALSE}
### import two analytic files -- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean for placement and los analysis and child_details_incidents_clean for incident analysis

## jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean
jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean <- readr::read_delim("C:\\Users\\abyrum\\The Council of State Governments\\JC Research - Documents\\JC Research - JJ_Michigan - JJ_Michigan\\Data\\Raw\\MDHHS\\Placements\\Analytic Files\\jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean.txt", delim = "|") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(legal_status_ward_flag)==TRUE) %>% ### this removes placements that have a legal status, but it's a legal status that is non-JJ according to MDHHS; we are using legal status to define all placements in the analysis so this is key
  mutate(placement_unique_id = paste0(person_id,placement_episode_segment,placement_episode_no),
           placement_episode_unique_id = paste0(person_id,placement_episode_segment)) %>%
  group_by(placement_episode_unique_id) %>% 
  mutate(prior_placement_living_arrangement = lag(living_arrangement),
         following_placement_living_arrangement = living_arrangement[placement_episode_no = placement_episode_no+1],
         placement_episode_ends_past_study = ifelse(is.na(placement_episode_end_date)==TRUE,1,0),
         placement_episode_does_count = ifelse(placement_episode_placement_does_count_total_none==0,1,0)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(placement_segment_placement_episode_counts = placement_episode_segment,
         placement_segment_placement_episode_counts = ifelse(placement_episode_does_count!=1,NA,placement_segment_placement_episode_counts)) %>%
  group_by(person_id) %>% 
  mutate(placement_episode_segment_episode_counts_only = rank(placement_segment_placement_episode_counts, ties.method = "min")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(post_cci_state_supervision_flag = ifelse(prior_placement_living_arrangement %in% c("Child Caring Institution","Out of State Child Caring Institution","MDHHS Training School") & living_arrangement %in% c("Adoptive Home","Boarding School, etc. (other)","College Dormitory","Friend/Partner Home","Independent Living","Licensed/Unlicensed Relative Home","Out of State Licensed Relative","Out of State Parental Home","Out of State Unlicensed Relative","Parental Home","Pre-Adoptive Home","Rental Home/Apartment","Terminated Parental Home","Unrelated Caregiver"),1,0),
         in_home_placement_flag = ifelse(living_arrangement %in% c("Adoptive Home","Boarding School, etc. (other)","College Dormitory","Friend/Partner Home","Independent Living","Licensed/Unlicensed Relative Home","Out of State Licensed Relative","Out of State Parental Home","Out of State Unlicensed Relative","Parental Home","Pre-Adoptive Home","Rental Home/Apartment","Terminated Parental Home","Unrelated Caregiver"),1,0),
         foster_placement_flag = ifelse(living_arrangement %in% c("Adult Foster Home","Licensed Unrelated Foster Home", "Private Agency Foster Care","Epic Guardianship Home","Juvenile Guardianship Home","Out of State Foster Home"),1,0),
         out_of_home_other_placement_flag = ifelse(living_arrangement %in% c("Emergency Residential Shelter", "Emergency Residential Home", "Hospital", "Court Treatment Facility", "Runaway Service Facility"),1,0),
         out_of_home_cci_state_placement_flag = ifelse(living_arrangement %in% c("Child Caring Institution","Out of State Child Caring Institution","MDHHS Training School"),1,0),
         out_of_home_cci_only_placement_flag = ifelse(living_arrangement %in% c("Child Caring Institution","Out of State Child Caring Institution"),1,0),
         out_of_home_state_only_placement_flag = ifelse(living_arrangement %in% c("MDHHS Training School"),1,0),
         out_of_home_jail_placement_flag = ifelse(living_arrangement %in%("Jail"),1,0),
         out_of_home_detention_placement_flag = ifelse(living_arrangement %in%("Detention"),1,0),
         out_of_home_all_placement_flag = ifelse(living_arrangement %in% c("Emergency Residential Shelter", "Hospital", "Court Treatment Facility", "Runaway Service Facility","Child Caring Institution","Detention","Jail","Community Justice Center","Out of State Child Caring Institution","MDHHS Training School"),1,0),
         post_cci_det_jail_supervision_additional_cci_det_jail_flag = ifelse(post_cci_state_supervision_flag==1 & following_placement_living_arrangement %in% c("Child Caring Institution","MDHHS Training School","Out of State Child Caring Institution"),1,0),
         in_home_out_home_flag_label = ifelse(in_home_placement_flag==1,"In Home", "Out of Home")) %>%
  group_by(placement_episode_unique_id) %>% 
  mutate(placements_within_episode = sum(placement_does_count, na.rm=TRUE),
         in_home_placements_within_episode = sum(in_home_placement_flag, na.rm=TRUE),
         out_of_home_cci_placements_within_episode = sum(out_of_home_cci_only_placement_flag, na.rm=TRUE),
         out_of_home_cci_state_placements_within_episode = sum(out_of_home_cci_state_placement_flag, na.rm=TRUE),
         out_of_home_state_placements_within_episode = sum(out_of_home_state_only_placement_flag, na.rm=TRUE),
         out_of_home_other_placements_within_episode = sum(out_of_home_other_placement_flag, na.rm=TRUE),
         out_of_home_jail_placements_within_episode = sum(out_of_home_jail_placement_flag, na.rm=TRUE),
         out_of_home_detention_placements_within_episode = sum(out_of_home_detention_placement_flag, na.rm=TRUE),
         placement_episode_contains_out_home_cci_mdhhs = max(out_of_home_cci_state_placement_flag)) %>% 
  ungroup()

```{r include=FALSE}
### group living arrangements into buckets based on feedback from Josh

# Here are our final coding decisions with the MDHHS placement data based on our meeting last week around what we are counting as a “placement” within each “placement episode”. 

# The following living arrangements are placement types which – in the analysis – do not count as unique individual placements, won’t count towards placements per episode metrics, and won’t count towards length of stay calculation (though I will (1) separate out placements episodes with only the following placements to highlight their frequency, (2) use in-home placements following out-of-home placements for post-out-of-home supervision analysis, (3) separate out detention and jail in analyses): 

#####	“Detention", "Jail", "Adoptive Home", "Parental Home", "Friend/Partner Home", "Licensed/Unlicensed Relative Home", "Unrelated Caregiver", "College Dormitory", "Boarding School, etc. (other)", "Terminated parental home", "Out of State Parental Home", "Out of State Licensed Relative", "Out of State Unlicensed Relative", "AWOL", "Escape", "Independent Living", "Rental Home/Apartment", "Pre-Adoptive Home", "NO MATCH FOUND"
# The following living arrangements are placement types which can constitute a placement episode, count as unique individual placements, count towards placements per episode, and count towards length of stay:

#####	"Adult Foster Home", "Agency" (indicates that "a youth is in an office overnight (at midnight)"), "Child Caring Institution", "Court Treatment Facility", "Emergency Residential Shelter", "Emergency Shelter Home", "EPIC Guardianship Home", "Hospital", "Mental Health Facility", "Juvenile Guardianship Home", "Licensed Unrelated Foster Home", "Out of State Child Caring Institution", "Out of State Foster Home", "Private Agency Foster Care", "Runaway Service Facility", "MDHHS Training School", "Community Justice Center" (closed prior to study window so won’t actually appear in final analysis)

jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %<>%
  mutate(living_arrangement_grouped_out_of_home_only = case_when(
    living_arrangement %in% c("Emergency Residential Shelter", "Hospital", "Court Treatment Facility", "Runaway Service Facility", "Emergency Residential Home") ~ 4,
    living_arrangement %in% c("Child Caring Institution","Out of State Child Caring Institution") ~ 2,
    living_arrangement %in% c("MDHHS Training School") ~ 1,
    living_arrangement %in% c("Adult Foster Home","Licensed Unrelated Foster Home", "Private Agency Foster Care","Epic Guardianship Home","Juvenile Guardianship Home","Out of State Foster Home") ~ 3,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    living_arrangement_grouped_out_of_home_only = factor(living_arrangement_grouped_out_of_home_only,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4),
         labels = c("MDHHS Facility","CCI","Foster Care","Other Out of Home (e.g. hospital, treatment, emergency shelter)"))) %>%  ### use factor function to assign labels to values
      mutate(living_arrangement_grouped_all = case_when(
      living_arrangement %in% c("Jail", "Detention") ~ 6,
      living_arrangement %in% c("Adoptive Home","Boarding School, etc. (other)","College Dormitory","Friend/Partner Home","Independent Living","Licensed/Unlicensed Relative Home","Out of State Licensed Relative","Out of State Parental Home","Out of State Unlicensed Relative","Parental Home","Pre-Adoptive Home","Rental Home/Apartment","Terminated Parental Home","Unrelated Caregiver") ~ 5,
    living_arrangement %in% c("Emergency Residential Shelter", "Hospital", "Court Treatment Facility", "Runaway Service Facility", "Emergency Residential Home") ~ 4,
    living_arrangement %in% c("Child Caring Institution","Out of State Child Caring Institution") ~ 2,
    living_arrangement %in% c("MDHHS Training School") ~ 1,
    living_arrangement %in% c("Adult Foster Home","Licensed Unrelated Foster Home", "Private Agency Foster Care","Epic Guardianship Home","Juvenile Guardianship Home","Out of State Foster Home") ~ 3,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    living_arrangement_grouped_all = factor(living_arrangement_grouped_all,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
         labels = c("MDHHS Facility","CCI","Foster Care","Other Out of Home","In Home", "Detention/Jail"))) %>% 
      mutate(prior_placement_living_arrangement_grouped_all = case_when(
      prior_placement_living_arrangement %in% c("Jail", "Detention") ~ 6,
      prior_placement_living_arrangement %in% c("Adoptive Home","Boarding School, etc. (other)","College Dormitory","Friend/Partner Home","Independent Living","Licensed/Unlicensed Relative Home","Out of State Licensed Relative","Out of State Parental Home","Out of State Unlicensed Relative","Parental Home","Pre-Adoptive Home","Rental Home/Apartment","Terminated Parental Home","Unrelated Caregiver") ~ 5,
    prior_placement_living_arrangement %in% c("Emergency Residential Shelter", "Hospital", "Court Treatment Facility", "Runaway Service Facility", "Emergency Residential Home") ~ 4,
    prior_placement_living_arrangement %in% c("Child Caring Institution","Out of State Child Caring Institution") ~ 2,
    prior_placement_living_arrangement %in% c("MDHHS Training School") ~ 1,
    prior_placement_living_arrangement %in% c("Adult Foster Home","Licensed Unrelated Foster Home", "Private Agency Foster Care","Epic Guardianship Home","Juvenile Guardianship Home","Out of State Foster Home") ~ 3,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    prior_placement_living_arrangement_grouped_all = factor(prior_placement_living_arrangement_grouped_all,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
         labels = c("MDHHS Facility","CCI","Foster Care","Other Out of Home","In Home", "Detention/Jail")))
```

## Example State Ward Placement Episode
```{r echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
### example case to highlight:

### using matt's code
df <- tribble(
  ~living_arrangments,   ~legal_status,    ~date_type,         ~date, ~order,
  "Detention", "JJ State Ward",  "start_dt", as.Date("2010-04-01"), 1,
  "Detention", "JJ State Ward",  "end_dt", as.Date("2011-06-01"), 1, 
  "Child Caring Institution", "JJ State Ward",   "start_dt", as.Date("2011-06-01"), 2, 
  "Child Caring Institution", "JJ State Ward",   "end_dt", as.Date("2013-06-01"), 2, 
  "MDHHS Facility", "JJ State Ward",   "start_dt",    as.Date("2013-08-01"), 4, 
  "MDHHS Facility", "JJ State Ward",   "end_dt",    as.Date("2015-03-01"), 4, 
  "Parental Home", "JJ State Ward",     "start_dt",      as.Date("2013-06-01"), 3, 
  "Parental Home", "JJ State Ward",     "end_dt",      as.Date("2013-08-01"), 3,
  "Relative Home", "JJ State Ward",     "start_dt",      as.Date("2015-03-01"), 5, 
  "Relative Home", "JJ State Ward",     "end_dt",      as.Date("2016-01-01"), 5) %>% 
  arrange(living_arrangments,date)

df %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    aes(date, reorder(living_arrangments,-order)),
    size = 16, color = "gray75",
    lineend = "round",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(df, date_type == "start_dt"),
    aes(date, living_arrangments, color = legal_status, shape = legal_status),
    size = 8
    ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Legal Status",
    shape = "Legal Status"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = c(0, 0)
    )
```

## MDHHS Placements

<br>

### Unique Placements, Placements Episodes, and Placements per Episode: 2015-2020 
NOTE: Year based on start of unique placement and placement episode (a unique placement may start in a different year than the placement episode to which it belongs)

**Filter = In-home and/or detention and jail placements excluded or placement episodes with only in-home and/or detention and jail removed**

```{r echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
### total unique placements
jj_assessments_unique_placements <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(`2015` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2015]),
            `2016` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2016]),
            `2017` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2017]),
            `2018` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2018]),
            `2019` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2019]),
            `2020` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2020]),
            `Overall` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)])) %>% 
    mutate(`Placement Grouping` = "Unique Placements, No Filter") 

### total unique placements
jj_assessments_unique_placements_with_filter <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(placement_does_count==1) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(`2015` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2015]),
            `2016` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2016]),
            `2017` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2017]),
            `2018` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2018]),
            `2019` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2019]),
            `2020` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year==2020]),
            `Overall` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)])) %>% 
    mutate(`Placement Grouping` = "Unique Placements, With Filter") 

### total unique placement episodes (year is year that placement episode starts; many placements in 2015-2020 started prior to 2015)
jj_assessments_unique_placement_episodes <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  summarize(`2015` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2015]),
            `2016` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2016]),
            `2017` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2017]),
            `2018` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2018]),
            `2019` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2019]),
            `2020` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2020]),
            `Overall` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)])) %>% 
    mutate(`Placement Grouping` = "Unique Placement Episodes, No Filter") 

### total unique placement episodes (year is year that placement episode starts; many placements in 2015-2020 started prior to 2015)
jj_assessments_unique_placement_episodes_with_filter <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>%
  filter(placement_episode_does_count==1) %>% 
  summarize(`2015` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2015]),
            `2016` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2016]),
            `2017` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2017]),
            `2018` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2018]),
            `2019` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2019]),
            `2020` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2020]),
            `Overall` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)])) %>% 
    mutate(`Placement Grouping` = "Unique Placement Episodes, With Filter") 

### total unique placements per placement episode
jj_assessments_unique_placements_per_episode <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(placement_episode_does_count==1) %>% 
  distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode
  summarize(`2015` = round(mean(placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2015]), digits = 1),
            `2016` = round(mean(placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2016]), digits = 1),
            `2017` = round(mean(placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2017]), digits = 1),
            `2018` = round(mean(placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2018]), digits = 1),
            `2019` = NA,
            `2020` = NA,
            `Overall` = round(mean(placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018)]), digits = 1)) %>% 
    mutate(`Placement Grouping` = "Mean Out of Home Placements per Episode, With Filter") 

### total unique placements per placement episode
jj_assessments_unique_placements_per_episode_in_home <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(placement_episode_does_count==1) %>% 
  distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode
  summarize(`2015` = round(mean(in_home_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2015]), digits = 1),
            `2016` = round(mean(in_home_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2016]), digits = 1),
            `2017` = round(mean(in_home_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2017]), digits = 1),
            `2018` = round(mean(in_home_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2018]), digits = 1),
            `2019` = NA,
            `2020` = NA,
            `Overall` = round(mean(in_home_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018)]), digits = 1)) %>% 
    mutate(`Placement Grouping` = "Mean In Home Placements per Episode, With Filter") 

### total unique placements per placement episode
jj_jj_out_of_home_per_episode <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(placement_episode_ends_past_study==0,
         placement_episode_does_count==1) %>% 
  distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode
  summarize(`2015` = round(mean(out_of_home_cci_state_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2015]), digits = 1),
            `2016` = round(mean(out_of_home_cci_state_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2016]), digits = 1),
            `2017` = round(mean(out_of_home_cci_state_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2017]), digits = 1),
            `2018` = round(mean(out_of_home_cci_state_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2018]), digits = 1),
            `2019` = NA,
            `2020` = NA,
            `Overall` = round(mean(out_of_home_cci_state_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018)]), digits = 1)) %>% 
    mutate(`Placement Grouping` = "Mean Out of Home CCI/MDHHS Placements per Episode, With Filter") 

### merge tables together
jj_assessments_unique_placement_count_table <- rbind(jj_assessments_unique_placements,jj_assessments_unique_placements_with_filter,jj_assessments_unique_placement_episodes,jj_assessments_unique_placement_episodes_with_filter,jj_assessments_unique_placements_per_episode,jj_jj_out_of_home_per_episode,jj_assessments_unique_placements_per_episode_in_home) %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Placement Grouping`, everything())

### print table via kableextra
kable(jj_assessments_unique_placement_count_table, format.args = list(drop0trailing = TRUE), align=rep('c')) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), row_label_position = "l") %>% 
  add_footnote("Unique placements per episode metric is excluded for 2019 and 2020 as it likely appears lower as a result of a smaller timeframe of analysis. Limiting analysis to episodes of 1-2 years only would address this limitation and allow for comparison", notation = "none")
```

### Placement Episodes by initial legal status  

```{r echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
### create overall file for denominator in % calculation below
jj_placement_episode_count_legal_status_denom <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(placement_episode_no==1,
         !is.na(legal_status_ward_flag)==TRUE,
         placement_episode_does_count==1) %>% ### because we are grouping episodes by initial legal status (thus only need first unique placement within each episode; must have legal status in first placement for now unless we change business rules)
  distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode
  summarize(`2015` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2015]),
            `2016` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2016]),
            `2017` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2017]),
            `2018` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2018]),
            `2019` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2019]),
            `2020` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2020]),
            `Overall` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)]))

### total unique placement episodes (year is year that placement episode starts; many placements in 2015-2020 started prior to 2015) 
jj_placement_episode_count_legal_status <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(placement_episode_no==1,
         !is.na(legal_status_ward_flag)==TRUE,
         placement_episode_does_count==1) %>% ### because we are grouping episodes by initial legal status (thus only need first unique placement within each episode; must have legal status in first placement for now unless we change business rules)
  distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode
  group_by(legal_status_ward_flag) %>% 
  summarize(`2015 (N)` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2015]),
            `2015 (%)` = round(n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2015])/jj_placement_episode_count_legal_status_denom$`2015`*100, digits = 1),
            `2016 (N)` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2016]),

### total unique placement episodes (year is year that placement episode starts; many placements in 2015-2020 started prior to 2015)
jj_placement_episode_count_disp_risk_placement_table <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(placement_does_count==1,
         !is.na(disposition_risk_level_earliest_use)==TRUE,
         place_no_of_earliest_cci_mdhhs == placement_episode_no,
         !is.na(living_arrangement_grouped_out_of_home_only)==TRUE,
         placement_begin_date_year%in%c(2016,2017,2018,2019,2020),
         legal_status_ward_flag == "State Ward") %>% ### because we are grouping episodes by initial disposition assessment; must have disposition_risk_level_earliest in first three placements for now unless we change business rules)
  # arrange(person_id,placement_episode_segment,placement_episode_no) %>% 
  # distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode
  group_by(living_arrangement_grouped_out_of_home_only) %>% 
  summarize(`Overall (N)` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id),
            `Low (N)` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use=="Low"]),
            `Low (%)` = scales::percent(n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use=="Low"])/n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use!="Missing"]), accuracy = .1),
            `Moderate (N)` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use=="Moderate"]),
            `Moderate (%)` =  scales::percent(n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use=="Moderate"])/n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use!="Missing"]), accuracy = .1),
            `High (N)` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use=="High"]),
            `High (%)` = scales::percent(n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use=="High"])/n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use!="Missing"]), accuracy = .1),
            `Missing (N)` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use=="Missing"]),
`Missing (%)` = scales::percent(n_distinct(placement_unique_id[disposition_risk_level_earliest_use=="Missing"])/`Overall (N)`, accuracy = .1)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(`Placement` = living_arrangement_grouped_out_of_home_only) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-`Overall (N)`)


### print table via kableextra
kable(jj_placement_episode_count_disp_risk_placement_table, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), align=rep('c')) %>%
   kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), row_label_position = "l") %>%

As a result the percentages for low, moderate, and high will add up to 100% and should be considered separately from the % missing row", notation = "none")

```{r echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
### create flag for each placement episode to note whether unique placements were at secure facilities
### use group_by and max
jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %<>%
  group_by(person_id,placement_episode_segment) %>% 
  mutate(secure_placement_flag = max(secure_facility),
         secure_placement_flag = ifelse(secure_placement_flag==1 & placement_does_count==1,"Included Secure Facility","Only Non-Secure")) %>% 
  ungroup()

  filter(!is.na(secure_placement_flag)==TRUE,
         placement_episode_does_count==1) %>% 
  distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode
  summarize(`2015` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2015]),
            `2016` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2016]),
            `2017` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2017]),
            `2018` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2018]),
            `2019` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2019]),
            `2020` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2020]),
            `Overall` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)])) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(`Disposition Assessment Risk Level` = "Overall") 

### total unique placement episodes (year is year that placement episode starts; many placements in 2015-2020 started prior to 2015)

  distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode
  group_by(secure_placement_flag) %>% 
  summarize(`2015 (N)` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2015]),
            `2015 (%)` = round(n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2015])/jj_placement_episode_secure_facility_overall$`2015`*100, digits = 1),
            `2016 (N)` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2016]),
            `2016 (%)` = round(n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2016])/jj_placement_episode_secure_facility_overall$`2016`*100, digits = 1),

            `2018 (N)` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year==2018]),

###	Placements by Age (age at time of placement episode start)
```{r echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
### create age bins
jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %<>%
  mutate(age_place_start_bin = case_when(
    age_placement_start<12 ~ 1,
    age_placement_start>=12 & age_placement_start<14 ~ 2,
    age_placement_start>=14 & age_placement_start<16 ~ 3,
    age_placement_start>=16 & age_placement_start<18 ~ 4,
    age_placement_start>=18 & age_placement_start<=21 ~ 5, ### using 21 for now; need to double check with soleil + team
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    age_place_start_bin = factor(age_place_start_bin,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4,5),
         labels = c("Less than 12", "12 to 14", "14 to 16","16 to 18","18+"))) ### use factor function to assign labels to values

### total unique placement episodes -- overall
### using only as denominator for percentages in jj_placement_episode_count_disp_risk_table
jj_placement_age_overall <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(!is.na(age_place_start_bin)==TRUE,
         placement_does_count==1) %>% 
  summarize(`Unique Placements` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020) & placement_does_count==1]),
`Unique Placement Episodes` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020) & placement_episode_no==1 & placement_episode_does_count==1]),
`Mean Placements per Episode` = round(mean(placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018) & placement_episode_no==1 & placement_episode_does_count==1])))  

### total unique placement episodes (year is year that placement episode starts; many placements in 2015-2020 started prior to 2015)
jj_placement_age_table <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(!is.na(age_place_start_bin)==TRUE,
         placement_does_count==1) %>% 
  group_by(age_place_start_bin) %>% 
  summarize(`Unique Placements (N)` = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020) & placement_does_count==1]),
            `Unique Placements (%)` = round(n_distinct(placement_unique_id[placement_begin_date_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020) & placement_does_count==1])/jj_placement_age_overall$`Unique Placements`*100, digits = 1),
`Unique Placement Episodes (N)` = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)  & placement_episode_no==1 & placement_episode_does_count==1]),
`Unique Placement Episodes (%)` = round(n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020) & placement_episode_no==1 & placement_episode_does_count==1])/jj_placement_age_overall$`Unique Placement Episodes`*100, digits = 1),
`Mean Placements per Episode` = round(mean(placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018) & placement_episode_no==1 & placement_episode_does_count==1]), digits = 1))   %>% 
  dplyr::rename(`Age, Binned` = age_place_start_bin) %>% 
  ungroup()

            `Overall` = round(sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_additional_out_placement_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)])/sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)])*100, digits = 1)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(`Initial Episode Legal Status` = legal_status_ward_flag)

### Frequency of subsequent out-of-home placement following post-out-of-home placement supervision (post_cci_det_jail_supervision_additional_out_placement_within_episode/post_cci_det_jail_supervision_placements_within_episode)
jj_post_out_of_home_supervision_additional_jj_place_percent_overall <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(placement_episode_no==1,
         !is.na(legal_status_ward_flag)==TRUE) %>% ### because we are grouping episodes by initial legal status (thus only need first unique placement within each episode; must have legal status in first placement for now unless we change business rules)

  summarize(`2015` = round(sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_additional_out_placement_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2015])/sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2015])*100, digits = 1),
            `2016` = round(sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_additional_out_placement_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2016])/sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2016])*100, digits = 1),
            `2017` = round(sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_additional_out_placement_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2017])/sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2017])*100, digits = 1),
            `2018` = round(sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_additional_out_placement_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2018])/sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2018])*100, digits = 1),
            `2019` = round(sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_additional_out_placement_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2019])/sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2019])*100, digits = 1),
            `2020` = round(sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_additional_out_placement_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2020])/sum(post_cci_det_jail_supervision_placements_within_episode[placement_episode_start_year==2020])*100, digits = 1),

### Unique placements episodes per 10k youth by county

```{r echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
### import ezapop race/ethnicity data for 10-17 y/o michigan residents for rate calculation
df_ezapop_race_ethnicity_10_17_county_level <- readr::read_delim("C:\\Users\\abyrum\\The Council of State Governments\\JC Research - Documents\\JC Research - JJ_Michigan - JJ_Michigan\\Data\\Ezapop\\ezapop_10_17_race_eth_sex_mi.txt", delim = "|") %>% 
  mutate(county_name =  gsub(" County", "", county_name)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(county_name,overall_10_17_population)

### create overall file for denominator in % calculation below
jj_placement_episode_county <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(!is.na(county_name)==TRUE) %>% 
  distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode where there is county data
  group_by(county_name) %>% 
  summarize(placement_episode_count = n_distinct(placement_episode_unique_id[placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020) & placement_episode_does_count==1])) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(df_ezapop_race_ethnicity_10_17_county_level, by = "county_name") %>% 
  mutate(placements_per_10k_youth = round(placement_episode_count/overall_10_17_population*10000, digits = 1))

### create quantiles object
no_classes <- 4

### extract quantiles from var we're mapping
quantiles <- jj_placement_episode_county %>%
  pull(placements_per_10k_youth) %>%
  quantile(probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = no_classes + 1), na.rm=TRUE) %>%
  as.vector() 

### make labels youth pop
label_place_rate <- c("44 to 220","22 to 44","8 to 22", "0 to 8")

### create a new variable with the specified quantiles
jj_placement_episode_county %<>%
  mutate(placements_per_10k_youth_quartile = cut(-placements_per_10k_youth,
                               breaks = -quantiles,
                               right = TRUE,
                               labels = label_place_rate,
                               include.lowest = T)) %>% 
  mutate(county_anonymous = paste0("County ", row_number())) 


### plot
ggplot(data = jj_placement_episode_county,
            mapping = aes(x = reorder(county_anonymous, placements_per_10k_youth), y = placements_per_10k_youth, fill = placements_per_10k_youth_quartile)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00475d","#007392","#0db4e4","#9ed4ef")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(min(0), 
                                           max(320))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::wrap_format(18)) +
  annotate("text", x = 55, y = 250, label = "Each bar represents one county's\n placement episode rate", colour = "#00475d", size = 4) +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          # panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.line=element_blank(),
          legend.position = "top",
        legend.title.align=0.5,
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank()) +
    labs(y = NULL, x = NULL,
      caption = NULL,
      title = NULL,
      subtitle = NULL,
      fill = "Placements per 10k Youth") +
    coord_flip() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE)) 
```

## Length of Stay

```{r include=FALSE}
### calculate length of stay in three different ways:
# los with everything counted 
# los split into only detention/cci/jail and post-out-of-home placement supervision (which for now is anything that is is a non-detention/cci/jail placement record following a detention/jail/cci placement)
jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %<>%
  # mutate(placement_episode_all_first_date = min(placement_begin_date),
  #        placement_episode_all_last_date = max(placement_end_date)) %>% 
  mutate(unique_placement_los = time_length(difftime(placement_end_date, placement_begin_date), unit = 'days'),
         los_unique_placement_cci_only = ifelse(living_arrangement%in%c("Child Caring Institution","Out of State Child Caring Institution"),unique_placement_los,NA),
         los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only = ifelse(living_arrangement%in%c("MDHHS Training School"),unique_placement_los,NA),
         los_unique_placement_detention_only = ifelse(living_arrangement%in%c("Detention"),unique_placement_los,NA)) %>% 
  group_by(placement_episode_unique_id) %>% 
  
  mutate(los_overall_all_included = sum(unique_placement_los[placement_does_count==1]),
         los_overall_all_included = ifelse(los_overall_all_included==0,NA,los_overall_all_included),
         los_overall_cci_mdhhs_only = sum(unique_placement_los[living_arrangement%in%c("Child Caring Institution","Out of State Child Caring Institution","MDHHS Training School")]),
         los_overall_cci_mdhhs_only = ifelse(los_overall_cci_mdhhs_only==0,NA,los_overall_cci_mdhhs_only),
         los_overall_cci_only = sum(unique_placement_los[living_arrangement%in%c("Child Caring Institution","Out of State Child Caring Institution")]),
         los_overall_cci_only = ifelse(los_overall_cci_only==0,NA,los_overall_cci_only),
         los_overall_mdhhs_only = sum(unique_placement_los[living_arrangement%in%c("MDHHS Training School")]),
         los_overall_mdhhs_only = ifelse(los_overall_mdhhs_only==0,NA,los_overall_mdhhs_only),
         los_overall_detention_only = sum(unique_placement_los[living_arrangement%in%c("Detention")]),
         los_overall_detention_only = ifelse(los_overall_detention_only==0,NA,los_overall_detention_only),
         los_overall_jail_only = sum(unique_placement_los[living_arrangement%in%c("Jail")]),
         los_overall_jail_only = ifelse(los_overall_jail_only==0,NA,los_overall_jail_only),
         los_overall_detention_other_out_of_home_only = sum(unique_placement_los[living_arrangement%in%c("Emergency Residential Shelter", "Hospital", "Court Treatment Facility", "Runaway Service Facility")]),
         los_overall_detention_other_out_of_home_only = ifelse(los_overall_detention_other_out_of_home_only==0,NA,los_overall_detention_other_out_of_home_only),
         los_overall_out_of_home_shelter_runaway_only = sum(unique_placement_los[living_arrangement%in%c("Emergency Residential Shelter", "Runaway Service Facility")]),
         los_overall_out_of_home_shelter_runaway_only = ifelse(los_overall_out_of_home_shelter_runaway_only==0,NA,los_overall_out_of_home_shelter_runaway_only),
         los_overall_hospital_treatment_only = sum(unique_placement_los[living_arrangement%in%c("Hospital","Court Treatment Facility")]),
         los_overall_hospital_treatment_only = ifelse(los_overall_hospital_treatment_only==0,NA,los_overall_hospital_treatment_only),
         los_overall_post_detention_cci_only = sum(unique_placement_los[post_cci_state_supervision_flag==1 & placement_episode_ends_past_study==0]),
         los_overall_post_detention_cci_only = ifelse(los_overall_post_detention_cci_only==0,NA,los_overall_post_detention_cci_only),
         los_overall_in_home_only = sum(unique_placement_los[in_home_placement_flag==1]),
         los_overall_in_home_only = ifelse(los_overall_in_home_only==0,NA,los_overall_in_home_only),
         los_overall_out_of_home_only = sum(unique_placement_los[out_of_home_all_placement_flag==1]),
         los_overall_out_of_home_only = ifelse(los_overall_out_of_home_only==0,NA,los_overall_out_of_home_only),
) %>% 
  ungroup()

```

            `Median Length of Stay, Other Out-of-Home (Days)` = round(median(los_overall_detention_other_out_of_home_only, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0)

  ~`Race/Ethnicity`,   ~`Mean Placement Episode Length (p-value)`, ~`Statistically Significant Difference? (episode length compared to White youth)`,    ~`Mean Length of Stay, CCI Out-of-Home (p-value)`, ~`Statistically Significant Difference? (CCI out-of-home length compared to White youth)`, ~`Mean Length of Stay, MDHHS Out-of-Home (p-value)`, ~`Statistically Significant Difference? (MDHHS out-of-home length compared to White youth)`,    ~`Mean Length of Stay, Detention Out-of-Home (p-value)`, ~`Statistically Significant Difference? (Detention out-of-home length compared to White youth)`,  ~`Mean Length of Stay, Jail Out-of-Home (p-value)`, ~`Statistically Significant Difference? (Jail out-of-home length compared to White youth)`,  ~`Mean Length of Stay, Treatment/Hospital Out-of-Home (p-value)`, ~`Statistically Significant Difference? (Treatment/Hospital out-of-home length compared to White youth)`,                                               
  "American Indian/Alaskan Native", ".895","No", ".539", "No",".861","No",".855","No",".221","No",".879","No",
  "Black", ".306", "No", ".729", "No", ".874","No",".000","Yes",".141","No",".330","No",
  "Hispanic", ".368","No", ".418", "No",".813","No",".088","Approaching Significance",".609","No",".360","No",
  "White", "NA", "NA","NA", "NA","NA","NA","NA","NA","NA","NA","NA","NA") 

### create df to highlight statistical significance from t-test
jj_los_mean_race_eth_t_test_table <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(placement_episode_start_year%in%c(2015,2016,2017,2018),
         race_csg_4 %in% c("American Indian/Alaskan Native","White","Black","Hispanic")) %>% ### because we are grouping episodes by initial legal status (thus only need first unique placement within each episode; must have legal status in first placement for now unless we change business rules)
    distinct(person_id,placement_episode_segment, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  dplyr::select(race_csg_4,los_overall_all_included,los_overall_cci_only,los_overall_mdhhs_only,los_overall_detention_only,los_overall_in_home_only,los_overall_jail_only,los_overall_hospital_treatment_only) %>% ### de-dup by person and placement episode since we want to take the mean of a value duplicated across all placements within placement episode; we want one record per youth per placement episode
  group_by(race_csg_4) %>%
  summarize(`Mean Placement Episode Length (Days)` = round(mean(los_overall_all_included, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0),
            `Mean Length of Stay, CCI Out-of-Home (Days)` = round(mean(los_overall_cci_only, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0),
            `Mean Length of Stay, MDHHS Out-of-Home (Days)` = round(mean(los_overall_mdhhs_only, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0),
            `Mean Length of Stay, Detention Out-of-Home (Days)` = round(mean(los_overall_detention_only, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0),
            `Mean Length of Stay, Jail Out-of-Home (Days)` = round(mean(los_overall_jail_only, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0),
            `Mean Length of Stay, Treatment/Hospital Out-of-Home (Days)` = round(mean(los_overall_hospital_treatment_only, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(`Race/Ethnicity` = race_csg_4)

jj_los_mean_race_eth_t_test_table <- inner_join(jj_los_mean_race_eth_t_test_table,jj_los_mean_race_eth_t_test_p_values, by="Race/Ethnicity") %>% 
  select(`Race/Ethnicity`,`Mean Placement Episode Length (Days)`,`Mean Placement Episode Length (p-value)`, `Statistically Significant Difference? (episode length compared to White youth)`, `Mean Length of Stay, CCI Out-of-Home (Days)`,`Mean Length of Stay, CCI Out-of-Home (p-value)`,`Statistically Significant Difference? (CCI out-of-home length compared to White youth)`, `Mean Length of Stay, MDHHS Out-of-Home (Days)`,`Mean Length of Stay, MDHHS Out-of-Home (p-value)`,`Statistically Significant Difference? (MDHHS out-of-home length compared to White youth)`,`Mean Length of Stay, Detention Out-of-Home (Days)`,`Mean Length of Stay, Detention Out-of-Home (p-value)`,`Statistically Significant Difference? (Detention out-of-home length compared to White youth)`,`Mean Length of Stay, Jail Out-of-Home (Days)`,`Mean Length of Stay, Jail Out-of-Home (p-value)`,`Statistically Significant Difference? (Jail out-of-home length compared to White youth)`,`Mean Length of Stay, Treatment/Hospital Out-of-Home (Days)`,`Mean Length of Stay, Treatment/Hospital Out-of-Home (p-value)`,`Statistically Significant Difference? (Treatment/Hospital out-of-home length compared to White youth)`)

### print table via kableextra
kable(jj_los_mean_race_eth_t_test_table, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), align=rep('c')) %>%
   kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), row_label_position = "l") %>% 
  add_footnote("Length of stay calculations excluded for placement episodes starting in 2019 and 2020 as it likely appears lower as a result of a smaller timeframe of analysis. Also, note that small samples -- like with the jail and treatment/hospital categories -- result in less statistical power which means the test isn't as reliable in detecting real differences between two groups", notation = "none")

### Detention, CCI, and MDHHS Length of Stay, Distribution of Individual Placements
```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

### create los bins
jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %<>%
  mutate(los_overall_cci_only_bin = case_when(
    los_unique_placement_cci_only<32 & !is.na(los_unique_placement_cci_only)==TRUE ~ 1, ### exclude records with no relevant placements
    los_unique_placement_cci_only>=32 & los_unique_placement_cci_only<91 ~ 2,
    los_unique_placement_cci_only>=91 & los_unique_placement_cci_only<181 ~ 3,
    los_unique_placement_cci_only>=181 & los_unique_placement_cci_only<=365 ~ 4, 
    los_unique_placement_cci_only>=365 & los_unique_placement_cci_only<=730 ~ 5, 
    los_unique_placement_cci_only>730 & !is.na(los_unique_placement_cci_only)==TRUE ~ 6, 
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    los_overall_cci_only_bin = factor(los_overall_cci_only_bin,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
         labels = c("Less than 1 Month", "1 to 3 Months", "3 to 6 Months","6 to 12 Months","12 to 24 Months","24 Months+"))) ### use factor function to assign labels to values

jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %<>%
  mutate(los_overall_mdhhs_only_bin = case_when(
    los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only<32 & !is.na(los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only)==TRUE ~ 1, ### exclude records with no relevant placements
    los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only>=32 & los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only<91 ~ 2,
    los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only>=91 & los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only<181 ~ 3,
    los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only>=181 & los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only<=365 ~ 4, 
    los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only>=365 & los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only<=730 ~ 5, 
    los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only>730 & !is.na(los_unique_placement_mdhhs_only)==TRUE ~ 6, 
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    los_overall_mdhhs_only_bin = factor(los_overall_mdhhs_only_bin,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
         labels = c("Less than 1 Month", "1 to 3 Months", "3 to 6 Months","6 to 12 Months","12 to 24 Months","24 Months+"))) ### use factor function to assign labels to values

jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %<>%
  mutate(los_overall_detention_only_bin = case_when(
    los_unique_placement_detention_only<32 & !is.na(los_unique_placement_detention_only)==TRUE ~ 1, ### exclude records with no relevant placements
    los_unique_placement_detention_only>=32 & los_unique_placement_detention_only<91 ~ 2,
    los_unique_placement_detention_only>=91 & los_unique_placement_detention_only<181 ~ 3,
    los_unique_placement_detention_only>=181 & los_unique_placement_detention_only<=365 ~ 4, 
    los_unique_placement_detention_only>=365 & los_unique_placement_detention_only<=730 ~ 5, 
    los_unique_placement_detention_only>730 & !is.na(los_unique_placement_detention_only)==TRUE ~ 6, 
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    los_overall_detention_only_bin = factor(los_overall_detention_only_bin,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
         labels = c("Less than 1 Month", "1 to 3 Months", "3 to 6 Months","6 to 12 Months","12 to 24 Months","24 Months+"))) ### use factor function to assign labels to values

### CCI
cci_los_overall_denom <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
    filter(placement_begin_date_year %in% c(2015,2016,2017,2018),
         placement_does_count==1,
         !is.na(los_overall_cci_only_bin)==TRUE) %>% 
  summarise(n_count = n_distinct(placement_unique_id))

cci_los_overall_grouped <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
    filter(placement_begin_date_year %in% c(2015,2016,2017,2018),
         placement_does_count==1,
         !is.na(los_overall_cci_only_bin)) %>% 
    group_by(los_overall_cci_only_bin) %>% 
  summarise(n_count = round(n_distinct(placement_unique_id)/(cci_los_overall_denom$n_count), digits = 2))

## use gather for line plot
cci_los_overall_table <- cci_los_overall_grouped %>%
  gather(year, value, `n_count`) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(los_bins = los_overall_cci_only_bin) %>% 
  mutate(facility = 'CCI')

### MDHHS

    filter(placement_begin_date_year %in% c(2015,2016,2017,2018),

         !is.na(los_overall_mdhhs_only_bin)==TRUE) %>% 
  summarise(n_count = n_distinct(placement_unique_id))

mdhhs_los_overall_grouped <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
    filter(placement_begin_date_year %in% c(2015,2016,2017,2018),

### Detention
detention_los_overall_denom <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>%

         !is.na(los_overall_detention_only_bin)==TRUE) %>%

detention_los_overall_grouped <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>%

## combine
combined_los_overall_table <- rbind(cci_los_overall_table,mdhhs_los_overall_table,detention_los_overall_table) %>% 
  mutate(facility = factor(facility,
         levels = c("Detention","MDHHS", "CCI")))
  
ggplot(data = combined_los_overall_table,
            mapping = aes(x = los_bins, y = value, fill = forcats::fct_rev(facility))) + 
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#007392","#0db4e4","#9ed4ef")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits=c(min(0), 
                                           max(1))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::wrap_format(18),limits = rev) +

    labs(y = NULL, x = NULL,
      caption = NULL,
      title = NULL,
      subtitle = NULL,
      fill = NULL) +
    coord_flip() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) + 
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = scales::percent(as.numeric(value), accuracy = 1), group = forcats::fct_rev(facility)),
                  position = position_dodge(width = .9),
                  direction = 'x',
                  hjust = 0.75,
                  label.padding = 0.05,
                   box.padding = 0.05,
                  fill = "white",
                  color = c("#007392","#007392","#007392","#007392","#007392","#007392",
                            "#0db4e4","#0db4e4","#0db4e4","#0db4e4","#0db4e4","#0db4e4",
                            "#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef"),
                  segment.color = NA,
                  fontface = "bold",
                  na.rm = TRUE,
                  show.legend = FALSE)

    los_overall_mdhhs_only>=365 & los_overall_mdhhs_only<=730 ~ 5, 
    los_overall_mdhhs_only>730 ~ 6, 
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    los_overall_mdhhs_only_grouped_bin = factor(los_overall_mdhhs_only_grouped_bin,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
         labels = c("Less than 1 Month", "1 to 3 Months", "3 to 6 Months","6 to 12 Months","12 to 24 Months","24 Months+"))) ### use factor function to assign labels to values

  # group_by(placement_episode_unique_id) %>%

  # ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(los_overall_detention_only_grouped_bin = case_when(
    los_overall_detention_only<32 & los_overall_detention_only!=0 ~ 1,
    los_overall_detention_only>=32 & los_overall_detention_only<91 ~ 2,
    los_overall_detention_only>=91 & los_overall_detention_only<181 ~ 3,
    los_overall_detention_only>=181 & los_overall_detention_only<=365 ~ 4, 
    los_overall_detention_only>=365 & los_overall_detention_only<=730 ~ 5, 
    los_overall_detention_only>730 ~ 6, 
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    los_overall_detention_only_grouped_bin = factor(los_overall_detention_only_grouped_bin,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
         labels = c("Less than 1 Month", "1 to 3 Months", "3 to 6 Months","6 to 12 Months","12 to 24 Months","24 Months+"))) ### use factor function to assign labels to values

  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits=c(min(0), 
                                           max(1))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::wrap_format(18),limits = rev) +
    theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "top",) +
    labs(y = NULL, x = NULL,
      caption = NULL,
      title = NULL,
      subtitle = NULL,
      fill = NULL) +
    coord_flip() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) + 
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = scales::percent(as.numeric(value), accuracy = 1), group = forcats::fct_rev(facility)),
                  position = position_dodge(width = .9),
                  direction = 'x',
                  hjust = 0.75,
                  label.padding = 0.05,
                   box.padding = 0.05,
                  fill = "white",
                  color = c("#007392","#007392","#007392","#007392","#007392","#007392",
                            "#0db4e4","#0db4e4","#0db4e4","#0db4e4","#0db4e4","#0db4e4",
                            "#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef","#9ed4ef"),
                  segment.color = NA,
                  fontface = "bold",
                  na.rm = TRUE,
                  show.legend = FALSE)

```{r include=FALSE,eval=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
## Incidents

### Incidents over time 
jj_provider_id_placement_year_count <- jj_assessments_placement_legal_status_clean %>% 
  filter(!is.na(provider_id)==TRUE,
         placement_end_date_year>=2015) %>% 
  group_by(provider_id,secure_facility) %>% 
  summarize(
            unique_placement_facility_year_count_2016 = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[(placement_begin_date_year<=2016 & (placement_end_date_year>=2016 | is.na(placement_end_date_year)==TRUE))]),
            unique_placement_facility_year_count_2017 = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[(placement_begin_date_year<=2017 & (placement_end_date_year>=2017 | is.na(placement_end_date_year)==TRUE))]),
            unique_placement_facility_year_count_2018 = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[(placement_begin_date_year<=2018 & (placement_end_date_year>=2018 | is.na(placement_end_date_year)==TRUE))]),
            unique_placement_facility_year_count_2019 = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[(placement_begin_date_year<=2019 & (placement_end_date_year>=2019 | is.na(placement_end_date_year)==TRUE))]),
            unique_placement_facility_year_count_2020 = n_distinct(placement_unique_id[(placement_begin_date_year<=2020 & (placement_end_date_year>=2020 | is.na(placement_end_date_year)==TRUE))])) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ### pivot wide to long by year
  pivot_longer(
   cols = starts_with("unique_placement_facility_year_count_"),
   names_to = "placement_year",
   names_prefix = "unique_placement_facility_year_count_",
   values_to = "placement_count",
   values_drop_na = FALSE
 ) %>% 
  mutate(placement_year = as.numeric(placement_year))

incidents_placements_count_year <- child_details_incidents_clean %>%
  distinct(person_id,incident_id,incident_type, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% ### de-dup by incident (only three duplicates)
  mutate(incident_date = ymd(incident_date),
         incident_year = year(incident_date),
         incident_unique_type_id = paste0(person_id,incident_id,incident_type),
         provider_type = ifelse(provider_name=="BAY PINES CENTER","Child Caring Institution", provider_type)) %>%
  filter(incident_year%in%c(2016,2017,2018,2019,2020)) %>% 
  mutate(incident_type_involves_restraint = ifelse(incident_type%in%c("Physical Restraint","Mechanical Restraint"),1,0),
         incident_type_involves_seclusion = ifelse(incident_type%in%c("Seclusion"),1,0)) %>%
  group_by(incident_id) %>% 
  mutate(incident_involves_restraint = ifelse(max(incident_type_involves_restraint, na.rm=TRUE)==1,1,0),
         incident_involves_seclusion = ifelse(max(incident_type_involves_seclusion, na.rm=TRUE)==1,1,0),
         incident_involves_no_restraint_no_seclusion = ifelse(incident_involves_restraint==0 & incident_involves_seclusion==0,1,0)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(provider_id,provider_name,living_arrangement,provider_category,provider_type,incident_year) %>% 
  summarize(unique_incidents_n = n_distinct(incident_id),
            unique_incident_count_involves_restraint = n_distinct(incident_id[incident_involves_restraint==1]),
            unique_incident_count_involves_seclusion = n_distinct(incident_id[incident_involves_seclusion==1]),
            unique_incident_count_involves_other_only = n_distinct(incident_id[incident_involves_no_restraint_no_seclusion==1])) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(jj_provider_id_placement_year_count, by = c("provider_id","incident_year"="placement_year")) %>% 
  mutate(cci_flag_label = ifelse(provider_type%in%c("Child Caring Institution","Child Caring Institution  Licensed Non-Paid Child Caring Institution","Child Caring Institution  Medical Services Provider","Child Caring Institution  Medical Subsidy Provider"),"CCI","Non-CCI"))

### all -- grouped by year
incidents_overall_count_year <- incidents_placements_count_year %>% 
  group_by(incident_year) %>% 
  summarise(
    # `Count of Unique Placements (N)` = sum(placement_count, na.rm=TRUE),
        `Count of Unique Incidents (N)` = sum(unique_incidents_n, na.rm=TRUE),
            `Incidents Involving Seclusion (N)` = sum(unique_incident_count_involves_seclusion),
            `Incidents Involving Seclusion (%)` = round(sum(unique_incident_count_involves_seclusion)/`Count of Unique Incidents (N)`*100, digits = 1),
            `Incidents Involving Restraint (N)` = sum(unique_incident_count_involves_restraint),
            `Incidents Involving Restraint (%)` = round(sum(unique_incident_count_involves_restraint)/`Count of Unique Incidents (N)`*100, digits = 1),
            `Incidents Involving Neither Seclusion or Restraint (N)` = sum(unique_incident_count_involves_other_only),
            `Incidents Involving Neither Seclusion or Restraint (%)` = round(sum(unique_incident_count_involves_other_only)/`Count of Unique Incidents (N)`*100, digits = 1)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(`Year of Incident` = incident_year) %>% 
  mutate(`Year of Incident` = as.character(`Year of Incident`))

### print table via kableextra
kable(incidents_overall_count_year, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), align=rep('c')) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), row_label_position = "l")
```
